# lua / lua_stringtonumber_test

lua's own fuzz target `lua_stringtonumber_test` ([source](source/lua_stringtonumber_test.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over lunapark (ligurio/lunapark at 14b0924d).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: lua_stringtonumber failure (returns 0) leaves the stack unchanged.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against lunapark at commit 14b0924d with 3 patches to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- lua_stringtonumber failure (returns 0) leaves the stack unchanged ([line 31](source/lua_stringtonumber_test.c#L31)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.
